title: Real restricted Fourier estimator output
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^{n}\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $S\subseteq J$ be finite, and let $m\in\mathbb{N}$. Given three $m$-tuples of Boolean inputs $z,y,y'$, the real output is the sum of the corresponding restricted Fourier weight observations divided by $m$.
caveat: The restricted Fourier weight observation is referenced but not defined in the supplied statement; the formula divides by $m$ without requiring $m>0$.
